en: Colored postcard view of a large military barracks complex with several multi‑story cream-colored buildings topped with steep red roofs arranged around a curved entrance road and fenced grounds. The foreground shows the main gate with striped guard posts, a curved driveway, and a perimeter wall. The background reveals open countryside under a blue sky with scattered clouds. Printed text in German appears at the top of the card indicating the town and the name of the barracks.
